ar: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ سُبْحَٰنَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَسْرَىٰ بِعَبْدِهِۦ لَيْلًا مِّنَ ٱلْمَسْجِدِ ٱلْحَرَامِ إِلَى ٱلْمَسْجِدِ ٱلْأَقْصَا ٱلَّذِى بَٰرَكْنَا حَوْلَهُۥ لِنُرِيَهُۥ مِنْ ءَايَٰتِنَآ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْبَصِيرُ
en: (1) Exalted[722] is He who took His Servant [i.e., Prophet Muḥammad (ﷺ)] by night from al-Masjid al-Ḥarām to al-Masjid al-Aqṣā,[723] whose surroundings We have blessed, to show him of Our signs. Indeed, He is the Hearing,[724] the Seeing.[725]
enNotes:
[722]- Above any imperfection or failure to do as He wills.
[723]- In Jerusalem.
[724]- Who hears every sound, distinguishes every voice, understands every word, and accepts and responds to supplications.
[725]- Who sees and understands all things apparent and unapparent, visible and invisible.
tr: Subḥānal-ladhī asrā biʿabdihī laylam minal-masjidil-ḥarāmi ilal-masjidil-aqṣal-ladhī bāraknā ḥawlahū linuriyahū min āyātinā, innahū huwas-samīʿul-baṣīr

ar: وَءَاتَيْنَا مُوسَى ٱلْكِتَٰبَ وَجَعَلْنَٰهُ هُدًى لِّبَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ أَلَّا تَتَّخِذُوا۟ مِن دُونِى وَكِيلًا
en: (2) And We gave Moses the Scripture and made it a guidance for the Children of Israel that you not take other than Me as Disposer of affairs,[726]
enNotes: [726]- i.e., trust in Allāh, knowing that He (subḥānahu wa taʿālā) is responsible for every occurrence.
tr: Waʾātaynā mūsal-kitāba wajaʿalnāhu hudal libanī isrāʾīla allā tattakhidhū min dūnī wakīlā

ar: ذُرِّيَّةَ مَنْ حَمَلْنَا مَعَ نُوحٍ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ عَبْدًا شَكُورًا
en: (3) O descendants of those We carried [in the ship] with Noah. Indeed, he was a grateful servant.
tr: Dhurriyyata man ḥamalnā maʿa nūḥ, innahū kāna ʿabdan shakūrā

ar: وَقَضَيْنَآ إِلَىٰ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ فِى ٱلْكِتَٰبِ لَتُفْسِدُنَّ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ مَرَّتَيْنِ وَلَتَعْلُنَّ عُلُوًّا كَبِيرًا
en: (4) And We conveyed[727] to the Children of Israel in the Scripture that, "You will surely cause corruption on the earth twice, and you will surely reach [a degree of] great haughtiness."
enNotes: [727]- Foretold out of divine knowledge of what they would do.
tr: Waqaḍaynā ilā banī isrāʾīla fil-kitābi latufsidunna fil-arḍi marratayni walataʿlunna ʿuluwwan kabīrā

ar: فَإِذَا جَآءَ وَعْدُ أُولَىٰهُمَا بَعَثْنَا عَلَيْكُمْ عِبَادًا لَّنَآ أُو۟لِى بَأْسٍ شَدِيدٍ فَجَاسُوا۟ خِلَٰلَ ٱلدِّيَارِ وَكَانَ وَعْدًا مَّفْعُولًا
en: (5) So when the [time of] promise came for the first of them,[728] We sent against you servants of Ours - those of great military might, and they probed [even] into the homes,[729] and it was a promise fulfilled.
enNotes:
[728]- i.e., the promised punishment for the first of their two transgressions.
[729]- Violating their sanctity, to kill and plunder.
tr: Faʾidhā jāʾa waʿdu ūlāhumā baʿathnā ʿalaykum ʿibādal lanā ulī baʾsin shadīdin fajāsū khilālad-diyār, wakāna waʿdam mafʿūlā

ar: ثُمَّ رَدَدْنَا لَكُمُ ٱلْكَرَّةَ عَلَيْهِمْ وَأَمْدَدْنَٰكُم بِأَمْوَٰلٍ وَبَنِينَ وَجَعَلْنَٰكُمْ أَكْثَرَ نَفِيرًا
en: (6) Then We gave back to you a return victory over them. And We reinforced you with wealth and sons and made you more numerous in manpower.
tr: Thumma radadnā lakumul-karrata ʿalayhim waʾamdadnākum biʾamwāliw wabanīna wajaʿalnākum akthara nafīrā

ar: إِنْ أَحْسَنتُمْ أَحْسَنتُمْ لِأَنفُسِكُمْ وَإِنْ أَسَأْتُمْ فَلَهَا فَإِذَا جَآءَ وَعْدُ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ لِيَسُـۥٓـُٔوا۟ وُجُوهَكُمْ وَلِيَدْخُلُوا۟ ٱلْمَسْجِدَ كَمَا دَخَلُوهُ أَوَّلَ مَرَّةٍ وَلِيُتَبِّرُوا۟ مَا عَلَوْا۟ تَتْبِيرًا
en: (7) [And said], "If you do good, you do good for yourselves; and if you do evil, [you do it] to them [i.e., yourselves]." Then when the final [i.e., second] promise came, [We sent your enemies] to sadden your faces and to enter the masjid [i.e., the temple in Jerusalem], as they entered it the first time, and to destroy what they had taken over with [total] destruction.
tr: In aḥsantum aḥsantum liʾanfusikum, waʾin asaʾtum falahā, faʾidhā jāʾa waʿdul-ākhirati liyasūʾū wujūhakum waliyadkhulul-masjida kamā dakhalūhu awwala marratiw waliyutabbirū mā ʿalaw tatbīrā

ar: عَسَىٰ رَبُّكُمْ أَن يَرْحَمَكُمْ وَإِنْ عُدتُّمْ عُدْنَا وَجَعَلْنَا جَهَنَّمَ لِلْكَٰفِرِينَ حَصِيرًا
en: (8) [Then Allāh said], "It is expected, [if you repent], that your Lord will have mercy upon you. But if you return [to sin], We will return [to punishment]. And We have made Hell, for the disbelievers, a prison-bed."
tr: ʿAsā rabbukum ay yarḥamakum, waʾin ʿuttum ʿudnā, wajaʿalnā jahannama lil-kāfirīna ḥaṣīrā

ar: إِنَّ هَٰذَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ يَهْدِى لِلَّتِى هِىَ أَقْوَمُ وَيُبَشِّرُ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ ٱلَّذِينَ يَعْمَلُونَ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ أَنَّ لَهُمْ أَجْرًا كَبِيرًا
en: (9) Indeed, this Qur’ān guides to that which is most suitable and gives good tidings to the believers who do righteous deeds that they will have a great reward
tr: Inna hādhal-qurʾāna yahdī lillatī hiya aqwamu wayubashshirul-muʾminīnal-ladhīna yaʿmalūnaṣ-ṣāliḥāti anna lahum ajran kabīrā

ar: وَأَنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ أَعْتَدْنَا لَهُمْ عَذَابًا أَلِيمًا
en: (10) And that those who do not believe in the Hereafter - We have prepared for them a painful punishment.
tr: Waʾannal-ladhīna lā yuʾminūna bil-ākhirati aʿtadnā lahum ʿadhāban alīmā

ar: وَيَدْعُ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ بِٱلشَّرِّ دُعَآءَهُۥ بِٱلْخَيْرِ وَكَانَ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ عَجُولًا
en: (11) And man supplicates for evil [when angry] as he supplicates for good, and man is ever hasty.[730]
enNotes: [730]- i.e., impatient, emotional, and acting without forethought.
tr: Wayadʿul-insānu bish-sharri duʿāʾahū bil-khayr, wakānal-insānu ʿajūlā

ar: وَجَعَلْنَا ٱلَّيْلَ وَٱلنَّهَارَ ءَايَتَيْنِ فَمَحَوْنَآ ءَايَةَ ٱلَّيْلِ وَجَعَلْنَآ ءَايَةَ ٱلنَّهَارِ مُبْصِرَةً لِّتَبْتَغُوا۟ فَضْلًا مِّن رَّبِّكُمْ وَلِتَعْلَمُوا۟ عَدَدَ ٱلسِّنِينَ وَٱلْحِسَابَ وَكُلَّ شَىْءٍ فَصَّلْنَٰهُ تَفْصِيلًا
en: (12) And We have made the night and day two signs, and We erased the sign of the night and made the sign of the day visible[731] that you may seek bounty from your Lord and may know the number of years and the account [of time]. And everything We have set out in detail.
enNotes: [731]- Or "giving sight."
tr: Wajaʿalnal-layla wan-nahāra āyatayni famaḥawnā āyatal-layli wajaʿalnā āyatan-nahāri mubṣiratal litabtaghū faḍlam mir rabbikum walitaʿlamū ʿadadas-sinīna wal-ḥisāb, wakulla shayʾin faṣṣalnāhu tafṣīlā

ar: وَكُلَّ إِنسَٰنٍ أَلْزَمْنَٰهُ طَٰٓئِرَهُۥ فِى عُنُقِهِۦ وَنُخْرِجُ لَهُۥ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ كِتَٰبًا يَلْقَىٰهُ مَنشُورًا
en: (13) And [for] every person We have imposed his fate upon his neck,[732] and We will produce for him on the Day of Resurrection a record which he will encounter spread open.
enNotes: [732]- i.e., after having instructed him, We have made him responsible for his own destiny.
tr: Wakulla insānin alzamnāhu ṭāʾirahū fī ʿunuqih, wanukhriju lahū yawmal-qiyāmati kitābay yalqāhu manshūrā

ar: ٱقْرَأْ كِتَٰبَكَ كَفَىٰ بِنَفْسِكَ ٱلْيَوْمَ عَلَيْكَ حَسِيبًا
en: (14) [It will be said], "Read your record. Sufficient is yourself against you this Day as accountant."
tr: Iqraʾ kitābak, kafā binafsikal-yawma ʿalayka ḥasībā

ar: مَّنِ ٱهْتَدَىٰ فَإِنَّمَا يَهْتَدِى لِنَفْسِهِۦ وَمَن ضَلَّ فَإِنَّمَا يَضِلُّ عَلَيْهَا وَلَا تَزِرُ وَازِرَةٌ وِزْرَ أُخْرَىٰ وَمَا كُنَّا مُعَذِّبِينَ حَتَّىٰ نَبْعَثَ رَسُولًا
en: (15) Whoever is guided is only guided for [the benefit of] his soul. And whoever errs only errs against it. And no bearer of burdens will bear the burden of another. And never would We punish until We sent a messenger.
tr: Manihtadā faʾinnamā yahtadī linafsih, waman ḍalla faʾinnamā yaḍillu ʿalayhā, walā taziru wāziratuw wizra ukhrā, wamā kunnā muʿadhdhibīna ḥattā nabʿatha rasūlā

ar: وَإِذَآ أَرَدْنَآ أَن نُّهْلِكَ قَرْيَةً أَمَرْنَا مُتْرَفِيهَا فَفَسَقُوا۟ فِيهَا فَحَقَّ عَلَيْهَا ٱلْقَوْلُ فَدَمَّرْنَٰهَا تَدْمِيرًا
en: (16) And when We intend to destroy a city, We command its affluent[733] but they defiantly disobey therein; so the word [i.e., deserved decree] comes into effect upon it, and We destroy it with [complete] destruction.
enNotes: [733]- To obey Allāh.
tr: Waʾidhā aradnā an nuhlika qaryatan amarnā mutrafīhā fafasaqū fīhā faḥaqqa ʿalayhal-qawlu fadammarnāhā tadmīrā

ar: وَكَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا مِنَ ٱلْقُرُونِ مِنۢ بَعْدِ نُوحٍ وَكَفَىٰ بِرَبِّكَ بِذُنُوبِ عِبَادِهِۦ خَبِيرًۢا بَصِيرًا
en: (17) And how many have We destroyed from the generations after Noah. And sufficient is your Lord, concerning the sins of His servants, as Aware and Seeing.
tr: Wakam ahlaknā minal-qurūni mim baʿdi nūḥ, wakafā birabbika bidhunūbi ʿibādihī khabīram baṣīrā

ar: مَّن كَانَ يُرِيدُ ٱلْعَاجِلَةَ عَجَّلْنَا لَهُۥ فِيهَا مَا نَشَآءُ لِمَن نُّرِيدُ ثُمَّ جَعَلْنَا لَهُۥ جَهَنَّمَ يَصْلَىٰهَا مَذْمُومًا مَّدْحُورًا
en: (18) Whoever should desire the immediate[734] - We hasten for him from it what We will to whom We intend. Then We have made for him Hell, which he will [enter to] burn, censured and banished.
enNotes: [734]- i.e., worldly gratifications.
tr: Man kāna yurīdul-ʿājilata ʿajjalnā lahū fīhā mā nashāʾu liman nurīdu thumma jaʿalnā lahū jahannam, yaṣlāhā madhmūmam madḥūrā

ar: وَمَنْ أَرَادَ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةَ وَسَعَىٰ لَهَا سَعْيَهَا وَهُوَ مُؤْمِنٌ فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ كَانَ سَعْيُهُم مَّشْكُورًا
en: (19) But whoever desires the Hereafter and exerts the effort due to it while he is a believer - it is those whose effort is ever appreciated [by Allāh].
tr: Waman arādal-ākhirata wasaʿā lahā saʿyahā wahuwa muʾminun faʾulāʾika kāna saʿyuhum mashkūrā

ar: كُلًّا نُّمِدُّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ وَهَٰٓؤُلَآءِ مِنْ عَطَآءِ رَبِّكَ وَمَا كَانَ عَطَآءُ رَبِّكَ مَحْظُورًا
en: (20) To each [category] We extend - to these and to those - from the gift of your Lord. And never has the gift of your Lord been restricted.
tr: Kullan numiddu hāʾulāʾi wahāʾulāʾi min ʿaṭāʾi rabbik, wamā kāna ʿaṭāʾu rabbika maḥẓūrā

ar: ٱنظُرْ كَيْفَ فَضَّلْنَا بَعْضَهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ وَلَلْـَٔاخِرَةُ أَكْبَرُ دَرَجَٰتٍ وَأَكْبَرُ تَفْضِيلًا
en: (21) Look how We have favored [in provision] some of them over others. But the Hereafter is greater in degrees [of difference] and greater in distinction.
tr: Unẓur kayfa faḍḍalnā baʿḍahum ʿalā baʿḍ, walalʾākhiratu akbaru darajātiw waʾakbaru tafḍīlā

ar: لَّا تَجْعَلْ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَٰهًا ءَاخَرَ فَتَقْعُدَ مَذْمُومًا مَّخْذُولًا
en: (22) Do not make [as equal] with Allāh another deity and [thereby] become censured and forsaken.
tr: Lā tajʿal maʿallāhi ilāhan ākhara fataqʿuda madhmūmam makhdhūlā

ar: وَقَضَىٰ رَبُّكَ أَلَّا تَعْبُدُوٓا۟ إِلَّآ إِيَّاهُ وَبِٱلْوَٰلِدَيْنِ إِحْسَٰنًا إِمَّا يَبْلُغَنَّ عِندَكَ ٱلْكِبَرَ أَحَدُهُمَآ أَوْ كِلَاهُمَا فَلَا تَقُل لَّهُمَآ أُفٍّ وَلَا تَنْهَرْهُمَا وَقُل لَّهُمَا قَوْلًا كَرِيمًا
en: (23) And your Lord has decreed that you worship not except Him, and to parents, good treatment. Whether one or both of them reach old age [while] with you, say not to them [so much as], "uff,"[735] and do not repel them but speak to them a noble word.
enNotes: [735]- An expression of disapproval or irritation.
tr: Waqaḍā rabbuka allā taʿbudū illā iyyāhu wabil-wālidayni iḥsānā, immā yablughanna ʿindakal-kibara aḥaduhumā aw kilāhumā falā taqul lahumā uffiw walā tanharhumā waqul lahumā qawlan karīmā

ar: وَٱخْفِضْ لَهُمَا جَنَاحَ ٱلذُّلِّ مِنَ ٱلرَّحْمَةِ وَقُل رَّبِّ ٱرْحَمْهُمَا كَمَا رَبَّيَانِى صَغِيرًا
en: (24) And lower to them the wing of humility out of mercy and say, "My Lord, have mercy upon them as they brought me up [when I was] small."
tr: Wakhfiḍ lahumā janāḥadh-dhulli minar-raḥmati waqur rabbirḥamhumā kamā rabbayānī ṣaghīrā

ar: رَّبُّكُمْ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا فِى نُفُوسِكُمْ إِن تَكُونُوا۟ صَٰلِحِينَ فَإِنَّهُۥ كَانَ لِلْأَوَّٰبِينَ غَفُورًا
en: (25) Your Lord is most knowing of what is within yourselves. If you should be righteous [in intention] - then indeed He is ever, to the often returning [to Him], Forgiving.[736]
enNotes: [736]- For those who intend righteousness, hastening to repent from sins and errors committed through human weakness, Allāh (subḥānahu wa taʿālā) promises forgiveness.
tr: Rabbukum aʿlamu bimā fī nufūsikum, in takūnū ṣāliḥīna faʾinnahū kāna lil-awwābīna ghafūrā

ar: وَءَاتِ ذَا ٱلْقُرْبَىٰ حَقَّهُۥ وَٱلْمِسْكِينَ وَٱبْنَ ٱلسَّبِيلِ وَلَا تُبَذِّرْ تَبْذِيرًا
en: (26) And give the relative his right, and [also] the poor and the traveler, and do not spend wastefully.[737]
enNotes: [737]- i.e., on that which is unlawful or in disobedience to Allāh.
tr: Waʾāti dhal-qurbā ḥaqqahū wal-miskīna wabnas-sabīli walā tubadhdhir tabdhīrā

ar: إِنَّ ٱلْمُبَذِّرِينَ كَانُوٓا۟ إِخْوَٰنَ ٱلشَّيَٰطِينِ وَكَانَ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنُ لِرَبِّهِۦ كَفُورًا
en: (27) Indeed, the wasteful are brothers of the devils, and ever has Satan been to his Lord ungrateful.
tr: Innal-mubadhdhirīna kānū ikhwānash-shayāṭīn, wakānash-shayṭānu lirabbihī kafūrā

ar: وَإِمَّا تُعْرِضَنَّ عَنْهُمُ ٱبْتِغَآءَ رَحْمَةٍ مِّن رَّبِّكَ تَرْجُوهَا فَقُل لَّهُمْ قَوْلًا مَّيْسُورًا
en: (28) And if you [must] turn away from them [i.e., the needy] awaiting mercy from your Lord which you expect,[738] then speak to them a gentle word.
enNotes: [738]- i.e., if you have not the means to give them at present.
tr: Waʾimmā tuʿriḍanna ʿanhumubtighāʾa raḥmatim mir rabbika tarjūhā faqul lahum qawlam maysūrā

ar: وَلَا تَجْعَلْ يَدَكَ مَغْلُولَةً إِلَىٰ عُنُقِكَ وَلَا تَبْسُطْهَا كُلَّ ٱلْبَسْطِ فَتَقْعُدَ مَلُومًا مَّحْسُورًا
en: (29) And do not make your hand [as] chained to your neck[739] or extend it completely[740] and [thereby] become blamed and insolvent.
enNotes:
[739]- i.e., refusing to spend.
[740]- i.e., being extravagant.
tr: Walā tajʿal yadaka maghlūlatan ilā ʿunuqika walā tabsuṭhā kullal-basṭi fataqʿuda malūmam maḥsūrā

ar: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ يَبْسُطُ ٱلرِّزْقَ لِمَن يَشَآءُ وَيَقْدِرُ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ بِعِبَادِهِۦ خَبِيرًۢا بَصِيرًا
en: (30) Indeed, your Lord extends provision for whom He wills and restricts [it]. Indeed He is ever, concerning His servants, Aware and Seeing.
tr: Inna rabbaka yabsuṭur-rizqa limay yashāʾu wayaqdir, innahū kāna biʿibādihī khabīram baṣīrā

ar: وَلَا تَقْتُلُوٓا۟ أَوْلَٰدَكُمْ خَشْيَةَ إِمْلَٰقٍ نَّحْنُ نَرْزُقُهُمْ وَإِيَّاكُمْ إِنَّ قَتْلَهُمْ كَانَ خِطْـًٔا كَبِيرًا
en: (31) And do not kill your children for fear of poverty. We provide for them and for you. Indeed, their killing is ever a great sin.
tr: Walā taqtulū awlādakum khashyata imlāq, naḥnu narzuquhum waʾiyyākum, inna qatlahum kāna khiṭʾan kabīrā

ar: وَلَا تَقْرَبُوا۟ ٱلزِّنَىٰٓ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ فَٰحِشَةً وَسَآءَ سَبِيلًا
en: (32) And do not approach unlawful sexual intercourse.[741] Indeed, it is ever an immorality and is evil as a way.
enNotes: [741]- i.e., avoid all situations that might possibly lead to it.
tr: Walā taqrabuz-zinā innahū kāna fāḥishah, wasāʾa sabīlā

ar: وَلَا تَقْتُلُوا۟ ٱلنَّفْسَ ٱلَّتِى حَرَّمَ ٱللَّهُ إِلَّا بِٱلْحَقِّ وَمَن قُتِلَ مَظْلُومًا فَقَدْ جَعَلْنَا لِوَلِيِّهِۦ سُلْطَٰنًا فَلَا يُسْرِف فِّى ٱلْقَتْلِ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ مَنصُورًا
en: (33) And do not kill the soul [i.e., person] which Allāh has forbidden, except by right.[742] And whoever is killed unjustly - We have given his heir authority,[743] but let him not exceed limits in [the matter of] taking life. Indeed, he has been supported [by the law].
enNotes:
[742]- i.e., through legal justice or during jihād.
[743]- Grounds for legal action.
tr: Walā taqtulun-nafsal-latī ḥarramallāhu illā bil-ḥaqq, waman qutila maẓlūman faqad jaʿalnā liwaliyyihī sulṭānan falā yusrif fil-qatl, innahū kāna manṣūrā

ar: وَلَا تَقْرَبُوا۟ مَالَ ٱلْيَتِيمِ إِلَّا بِٱلَّتِى هِىَ أَحْسَنُ حَتَّىٰ يَبْلُغَ أَشُدَّهُۥ وَأَوْفُوا۟ بِٱلْعَهْدِ إِنَّ ٱلْعَهْدَ كَانَ مَسْـُٔولًا
en: (34) And do not approach the property of an orphan, except in the way that is best,[744] until he reaches maturity. And fulfill [every] commitment. Indeed, the commitment is ever [that about which one will be] questioned.
enNotes: [744]- i.e., to improve or increase it.
tr: Walā taqrabū mālal-yatīmi illā bil-latī hiya aḥsanu ḥattā yablugha ashuddah, waʾawfū bil-ʿahd, innal-ʿahda kāna masʾūlā

ar: وَأَوْفُوا۟ ٱلْكَيْلَ إِذَا كِلْتُمْ وَزِنُوا۟ بِٱلْقِسْطَاسِ ٱلْمُسْتَقِيمِ ذَٰلِكَ خَيْرٌ وَأَحْسَنُ تَأْوِيلًا
en: (35) And give full measure when you measure, and weigh with an even [i.e., honest] balance. That is the best [way] and best in result.
tr: Waʾawful-kayla idhā kiltum wazinū bil-qisṭāsil-mustaqīm, dhālika khayruw waʾaḥsanu taʾwīlā

ar: وَلَا تَقْفُ مَا لَيْسَ لَكَ بِهِۦ عِلْمٌ إِنَّ ٱلسَّمْعَ وَٱلْبَصَرَ وَٱلْفُؤَادَ كُلُّ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ كَانَ عَنْهُ مَسْـُٔولًا
en: (36) And do not pursue[745] that of which you have no knowledge. Indeed, the hearing, the sight and the heart - about all those [one] will be questioned.
enNotes: [745]- i.e., do not assume and do not say.
tr: Walā taqfu mā laysa laka bihī ʿilm, innas-samʿa wal-baṣara wal-fuʾāda kullu ulāʾika kāna ʿanhu masʾūlā

ar: وَلَا تَمْشِ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ مَرَحًا إِنَّكَ لَن تَخْرِقَ ٱلْأَرْضَ وَلَن تَبْلُغَ ٱلْجِبَالَ طُولًا
en: (37) And do not walk upon the earth exultantly. Indeed, you will never tear the earth [apart], and you will never reach the mountains in height.[746]
enNotes: [746]- Man, for all his arrogance, is yet a weak and small creature.
tr: Walā tamshi fil-arḍi maraḥā, innaka lan takhriqal-arḍa walan tablughal-jibāla ṭūlā

ar: كُلُّ ذَٰلِكَ كَانَ سَيِّئُهُۥ عِندَ رَبِّكَ مَكْرُوهًا
en: (38) All that [i.e., the aforementioned] - its evil is ever, in the sight of your Lord, detested.
tr: Kullu dhālika kāna sayyiʾuhū ʿinda rabbika makrūhā

ar: ذَٰلِكَ مِمَّآ أَوْحَىٰٓ إِلَيْكَ رَبُّكَ مِنَ ٱلْحِكْمَةِ وَلَا تَجْعَلْ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَٰهًا ءَاخَرَ فَتُلْقَىٰ فِى جَهَنَّمَ مَلُومًا مَّدْحُورًا
en: (39) That is from what your Lord has revealed to you, [O Muḥammad], of wisdom. And, [O mankind], do not make [as equal] with Allāh another deity, lest you be thrown into Hell, blamed and banished.
tr: Dhālika mimmā awḥā ilayka rabbuka minal-ḥikmah, walā tajʿal maʿallāhi ilāhan ākhara fatulqā fī jahannama malūmam madḥūrā

ar: أَفَأَصْفَىٰكُمْ رَبُّكُم بِٱلْبَنِينَ وَٱتَّخَذَ مِنَ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةِ إِنَٰثًا إِنَّكُمْ لَتَقُولُونَ قَوْلًا عَظِيمًا
en: (40) Then, has your Lord chosen you for [having] sons and taken [i.e., adopted] from among the angels daughters? Indeed, you say a grave saying.
tr: Afaʾaṣfākum rabbukum bil-banīna wattakhadha minal-malāʾikati ināthā, innakum lataqūlūna qawlan ʿaẓīmā

ar: وَلَقَدْ صَرَّفْنَا فِى هَٰذَا ٱلْقُرْءَانِ لِيَذَّكَّرُوا۟ وَمَا يَزِيدُهُمْ إِلَّا نُفُورًا
en: (41) And We have certainly diversified [the contents] in this Qur’ān that they [i.e., mankind] may be reminded, but it does not increase them [i.e., the disbelievers] except in aversion.
tr: Walaqad ṣarrafnā fī hādhal-qurʾāni liyadhdhakkarū, wamā yazīduhum illā nufūrā

ar: قُل لَّوْ كَانَ مَعَهُۥٓ ءَالِهَةٌ كَمَا يَقُولُونَ إِذًا لَّٱبْتَغَوْا۟ إِلَىٰ ذِى ٱلْعَرْشِ سَبِيلًا
en: (42) Say, [O Muḥammad], "If there had been with Him [other] gods, as they say, then they [each] would have sought to the Owner of the Throne a way."[747]
enNotes: [747]- To please Him, recognizing His superiority. Another interpretation is "...they would seek a way" to depose Him (subḥānahu wa taʿālā) and take over His Throne.
tr: Qul law kāna maʿahū ālihatun kamā yaqūlūna idhal labtaghaw ilā dhil-ʿarshi sabīlā

ar: سُبْحَٰنَهُۥ وَتَعَٰلَىٰ عَمَّا يَقُولُونَ عُلُوًّا كَبِيرًا
en: (43) Exalted is He and high above what they say by great sublimity.
tr: Subḥānahū wataʿālā ʿammā yaqūlūna ʿuluwwan kabīrā

ar: تُسَبِّحُ لَهُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتُ ٱلسَّبْعُ وَٱلْأَرْضُ وَمَن فِيهِنَّ وَإِن مِّن شَىْءٍ إِلَّا يُسَبِّحُ بِحَمْدِهِۦ وَلَٰكِن لَّا تَفْقَهُونَ تَسْبِيحَهُمْ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ حَلِيمًا غَفُورًا
en: (44) The seven heavens and the earth and whatever is in them exalt Him. And there is not a thing except that it exalts [Allāh] by His praise, but you do not understand their [way of] exalting. Indeed, He is ever Forbearing[748] and Forgiving.
enNotes: [748]- Refer to footnote in 2:225.
tr: Tusabbiḥu lahus-samāwātus-sabʿu wal-arḍu waman fīhinn, waʾim min shayʾin illā yusabbiḥu biḥamdihī walākil lā tafqahūna tasbīḥahum, innahū kāna ḥalīman ghafūrā

ar: وَإِذَا قَرَأْتَ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ جَعَلْنَا بَيْنَكَ وَبَيْنَ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ حِجَابًا مَّسْتُورًا
en: (45) And when you recite the Qur’ān, We put between you and those who do not believe in the Hereafter a concealed partition.[749]
enNotes: [749]- Preventing guidance from reaching them.
tr: Waʾidhā qaraʾtal-qurʾāna jaʿalnā baynaka wabaynal-ladhīna lā yuʾminūna bil-ākhirati ḥijābam mastūrā

ar: وَجَعَلْنَا عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِمْ أَكِنَّةً أَن يَفْقَهُوهُ وَفِىٓ ءَاذَانِهِمْ وَقْرًا وَإِذَا ذَكَرْتَ رَبَّكَ فِى ٱلْقُرْءَانِ وَحْدَهُۥ وَلَّوْا۟ عَلَىٰٓ أَدْبَٰرِهِمْ نُفُورًا
en: (46) And We have placed over their hearts coverings, lest they understand it, and in their ears deafness. And when you mention your Lord alone in the Qur’ān, they turn back in aversion.
tr: Wajaʿalnā ʿalā qulūbihim akinnatan ay yafqahūhu wafī ādhānihim waqrā, waʾidhā dhakarta rabbaka fil-qurʾāni waḥdahū wallaw ʿalā adbārihim nufūrā

ar: نَّحْنُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا يَسْتَمِعُونَ بِهِۦٓ إِذْ يَسْتَمِعُونَ إِلَيْكَ وَإِذْ هُمْ نَجْوَىٰٓ إِذْ يَقُولُ ٱلظَّٰلِمُونَ إِن تَتَّبِعُونَ إِلَّا رَجُلًا مَّسْحُورًا
en: (47) We are most knowing of how they listen to it when they listen to you and [of] when they are in private conversation, when the wrongdoers say, "You follow not but a man affected by magic."
tr: Naḥnu aʿlamu bimā yastamiʿūna bihī idh yastamiʿūna ilayka waʾidh hum najwā idh yaqūluẓ-ẓālimūna in tattabiʿūna illā rajulam masḥūrā

ar: ٱنظُرْ كَيْفَ ضَرَبُوا۟ لَكَ ٱلْأَمْثَالَ فَضَلُّوا۟ فَلَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ سَبِيلًا
en: (48) Look how they strike for you comparisons;[750] but they have strayed, so they cannot [find] a way.
enNotes: [750]- Describing the Prophet (ﷺ) as a poet, a madman or one under the influence of sorcery.
tr: Unẓur kayfa ḍarabū lakal-amthāla faḍallū falā yastaṭīʿūna sabīlā

ar: وَقَالُوٓا۟ أَءِذَا كُنَّا عِظَٰمًا وَرُفَٰتًا أَءِنَّا لَمَبْعُوثُونَ خَلْقًا جَدِيدًا
en: (49) And they say, "When we are bones and crumbled particles, will we [truly] be resurrected as a new creation?"
tr: Waqālū aʾidhā kunnā ʿiẓāmaw warufātan aʾinnā lamabʿūthūna khalqan jadīdā

ar: قُلْ كُونُوا۟ حِجَارَةً أَوْ حَدِيدًا
en: (50) Say, "Be you stones or iron[751]
enNotes: [751]- i.e., even if you should be stones or iron.
tr: Qul kūnū ḥijāratan aw ḥadīdā

ar: أَوْ خَلْقًا مِّمَّا يَكْبُرُ فِى صُدُورِكُمْ فَسَيَقُولُونَ مَن يُعِيدُنَا قُلِ ٱلَّذِى فَطَرَكُمْ أَوَّلَ مَرَّةٍ فَسَيُنْغِضُونَ إِلَيْكَ رُءُوسَهُمْ وَيَقُولُونَ مَتَىٰ هُوَ قُلْ عَسَىٰٓ أَن يَكُونَ قَرِيبًا
en: (51) Or [any] creation of that which is great[752] within your breasts." And they will say, "Who will restore us?" Say, "He who brought you forth the first time." Then they will nod their heads toward you[753] and say, "When is that?" Say, "Perhaps it will be soon -
enNotes:
[752]- Such as the heavens and earth.
[753]- In disbelief and ridicule.
tr: Aw khalqam mimmā yakburu fī ṣudūrikum, fasayaqūlūna may yuʿīdunā, qulil-ladhī faṭarakum awwala marrah, fasayunghiḍūna ilayka ruʾūsahum wayaqūlūna matā huw, qul ʿasā ay yakūna qarībā

ar: يَوْمَ يَدْعُوكُمْ فَتَسْتَجِيبُونَ بِحَمْدِهِۦ وَتَظُنُّونَ إِن لَّبِثْتُمْ إِلَّا قَلِيلًا
en: (52) On the Day He will call you and you will respond with praise of Him and think that you had not remained [in the world] except for a little."
tr: Yawma yadʿūkum fatastajībūna biḥamdihī wataẓunnūna il labithtum illā qalīlā

ar: وَقُل لِّعِبَادِى يَقُولُوا۟ ٱلَّتِى هِىَ أَحْسَنُ إِنَّ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنَ يَنزَغُ بَيْنَهُمْ إِنَّ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنَ كَانَ لِلْإِنسَٰنِ عَدُوًّا مُّبِينًا
en: (53) And tell My servants to say that which is best. Indeed, Satan induces [dissension] among them. Indeed Satan is ever, to mankind, a clear enemy.
tr: Waqul liʿibādī yaqūlul-latī hiya aḥsan, innash-shayṭāna yanzaghu baynahum, innash-shayṭāna kāna lil-insāni ʿaduwwam mubīnā

ar: رَّبُّكُمْ أَعْلَمُ بِكُمْ إِن يَشَأْ يَرْحَمْكُمْ أَوْ إِن يَشَأْ يُعَذِّبْكُمْ وَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَٰكَ عَلَيْهِمْ وَكِيلًا
en: (54) Your Lord is most knowing of you. If He wills, He will have mercy upon you; or if He wills, He will punish you. And We have not sent you, [O Muḥammad], over them as a manager.
tr: Rabbukum aʿlamu bikum iy yashaʾ yarḥamkum aw iy yashaʾ yuʿadhdhibkum, wamā arsalnāka ʿalayhim wakīlā

ar: وَرَبُّكَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَن فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَقَدْ فَضَّلْنَا بَعْضَ ٱلنَّبِيِّـۧنَ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ وَءَاتَيْنَا دَاوُۥدَ زَبُورًا
en: (55) And your Lord is most knowing of whoever is in the heavens and the earth. And We have made some of the prophets exceed others [in various ways], and to David We gave the book [of Psalms].
tr: Warabbuka aʿlamu biman fis-samāwāti wal-arḍ, walaqad faḍḍalnā baʿḍan-nabiyyīna ʿalā baʿḍiw waʾātaynā dāwūda zabūrā

ar: قُلِ ٱدْعُوا۟ ٱلَّذِينَ زَعَمْتُم مِّن دُونِهِۦ فَلَا يَمْلِكُونَ كَشْفَ ٱلضُّرِّ عَنكُمْ وَلَا تَحْوِيلًا
en: (56) Say, "Invoke those you have claimed [as gods] besides Him, for they do not possess the [ability for] removal of adversity from you or [for its] transfer [to someone else]."
tr: Qulidʿul-ladhīna zaʿamtum min dūnihī falā yamlikūna kashfaḍ-ḍurri ʿankum walā taḥwīlā

ar: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ يَدْعُونَ يَبْتَغُونَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِمُ ٱلْوَسِيلَةَ أَيُّهُمْ أَقْرَبُ وَيَرْجُونَ رَحْمَتَهُۥ وَيَخَافُونَ عَذَابَهُۥٓ إِنَّ عَذَابَ رَبِّكَ كَانَ مَحْذُورًا
en: (57) Those whom they invoke[754] seek means of access to their Lord, [striving as to] which of them would be nearest, and they hope for His mercy and fear His punishment. Indeed, the punishment of your Lord is ever feared.
enNotes: [754]- Among the righteous of Allāh's creation, such as angels, prophets, deceased scholars, etc.
tr: Ulāʾikal-ladhīna yadʿūna yabtaghūna ilā rabbihimul-wasīlata ayyuhum aqrabu wayarjūna raḥmatahū wayakhāfūna ʿadhābah, inna ʿadhāba rabbika kāna maḥdhūrā

ar: وَإِن مِّن قَرْيَةٍ إِلَّا نَحْنُ مُهْلِكُوهَا قَبْلَ يَوْمِ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ أَوْ مُعَذِّبُوهَا عَذَابًا شَدِيدًا كَانَ ذَٰلِكَ فِى ٱلْكِتَٰبِ مَسْطُورًا
en: (58) And there is no city but that We will destroy it[755] before the Day of Resurrection or punish it with a severe punishment. That has ever been in the Register[756] inscribed.
enNotes:
[755]- Because of the sins of its inhabitants.
[756]- The Preserved Slate (al-Lawḥ al-Maḥfūẓ), which is with Allāh.
tr: Waʾim min qaryatin illā naḥnu muhlikūhā qabla yawmil-qiyāmati aw muʿadhdhibūhā ʿadhāban shadīdā, kāna dhālika fil-kitābi masṭūrā

ar: وَمَا مَنَعَنَآ أَن نُّرْسِلَ بِٱلْـَٔايَٰتِ إِلَّآ أَن كَذَّبَ بِهَا ٱلْأَوَّلُونَ وَءَاتَيْنَا ثَمُودَ ٱلنَّاقَةَ مُبْصِرَةً فَظَلَمُوا۟ بِهَا وَمَا نُرْسِلُ بِٱلْـَٔايَٰتِ إِلَّا تَخْوِيفًا
en: (59) And nothing has prevented Us from sending signs [i.e., miracles] except that the former peoples denied them. And We gave Thamūd the she-camel as a visible sign, but they wronged her. And We send not the signs except as a warning.
tr: Wamā manaʿanā an nursila bil-āyāti illā an kadhdhaba bihal-awwalūn, waʾātaynā thamūdan-nāqata mubṣiratan faẓalamū bihā, wamā nursilu bil-āyāti illā takhwīfā

ar: وَإِذْ قُلْنَا لَكَ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ أَحَاطَ بِٱلنَّاسِ وَمَا جَعَلْنَا ٱلرُّءْيَا ٱلَّتِىٓ أَرَيْنَٰكَ إِلَّا فِتْنَةً لِّلنَّاسِ وَٱلشَّجَرَةَ ٱلْمَلْعُونَةَ فِى ٱلْقُرْءَانِ وَنُخَوِّفُهُمْ فَمَا يَزِيدُهُمْ إِلَّا طُغْيَٰنًا كَبِيرًا
en: (60) And [remember, O Muḥammad], when We told you, "Indeed, your Lord has encompassed the people."[757] And We did not make the sight which We showed you[758] except as a trial for the people, as was the accursed tree [mentioned] in the Qur’ān. And We threaten [i.e., warn] them, but it increases them not except in great transgression.
enNotes:
[757]- In His knowledge and power, meaning that Allāh would protect him (ﷺ) from their harm.
[758]- During the miʿrāj (ascension) into the heavens.
tr: Waʾidh qulnā laka inna rabbaka aḥāṭa bin-nās, wamā jaʿalnar-ruʾyal-latī araynāka illā fitnatal lin-nāsi wash-shajaratal-malʿūnata fil-qurʾān, wanukhawwifuhum famā yazīduhum illā ṭughyānan kabīrā

ar: وَإِذْ قُلْنَا لِلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةِ ٱسْجُدُوا۟ لِـَٔادَمَ فَسَجَدُوٓا۟ إِلَّآ إِبْلِيسَ قَالَ ءَأَسْجُدُ لِمَنْ خَلَقْتَ طِينًا
en: (61) And [mention] when We said to the angels, "Prostrate to Adam," and they prostrated, except for Iblees.[759] He said, "Should I prostrate to one You created from clay?"
enNotes: [759]- See footnote to 2:34.
tr: Waʾidh qulnā lil-malāʾikatisjudū liʾādama fasajadū illā iblīs, qāla aʾasjudu liman khalaqta ṭīnā

ar: قَالَ أَرَءَيْتَكَ هَٰذَا ٱلَّذِى كَرَّمْتَ عَلَىَّ لَئِنْ أَخَّرْتَنِ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ لَأَحْتَنِكَنَّ ذُرِّيَّتَهُۥٓ إِلَّا قَلِيلًا
en: (62) [Iblees] said, "Do You see this one whom You have honored above me? If You delay me [i.e., my death] until the Day of Resurrection, I will surely destroy[760] his descendants, except for a few."
enNotes: [760]- By tempting them and leading them astray.
tr: Qāla araʾaytaka hādhal-ladhī karramta ʿalayya laʾin akhkhartani ilā yawmil-qiyāmati laʾaḥtanikanna dhurriyyatahū illā qalīlā

ar: قَالَ ٱذْهَبْ فَمَن تَبِعَكَ مِنْهُمْ فَإِنَّ جَهَنَّمَ جَزَآؤُكُمْ جَزَآءً مَّوْفُورًا
en: (63) [Allāh] said, "Go, for whoever of them follows you, indeed Hell will be the recompense of [all of] you - an ample recompense.
tr: Qāladhhab faman tabiʿaka minhum faʾinna jahannama jazāʾukum jazāʾam mawfūrā

ar: وَٱسْتَفْزِزْ مَنِ ٱسْتَطَعْتَ مِنْهُم بِصَوْتِكَ وَأَجْلِبْ عَلَيْهِم بِخَيْلِكَ وَرَجِلِكَ وَشَارِكْهُمْ فِى ٱلْأَمْوَٰلِ وَٱلْأَوْلَٰدِ وَعِدْهُمْ وَمَا يَعِدُهُمُ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنُ إِلَّا غُرُورًا
en: (64) And incite [to senselessness] whoever you can among them with your voice and assault them with your horses and foot soldiers and become a partner in their wealth and their children and promise them." But Satan does not promise them except delusion.
tr: Wastafziz manistaṭaʿta minhum biṣawtika waʾajlib ʿalayhim bikhaylika warajilika washārikhum fil-amwāli wal-awlādi waʿidhum, wamā yaʿiduhumush-shayṭānu illā ghurūrā

ar: إِنَّ عِبَادِى لَيْسَ لَكَ عَلَيْهِمْ سُلْطَٰنٌ وَكَفَىٰ بِرَبِّكَ وَكِيلًا
en: (65) Indeed, over My [believing] servants there is for you no authority. And sufficient is your Lord as Disposer of affairs.[761]
enNotes: [761]- Refer to footnote in 3: 173.
tr: Inna ʿibādī laysa laka ʿalayhim sulṭān, wakafā birabbika wakīlā

ar: رَّبُّكُمُ ٱلَّذِى يُزْجِى لَكُمُ ٱلْفُلْكَ فِى ٱلْبَحْرِ لِتَبْتَغُوا۟ مِن فَضْلِهِۦٓ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ بِكُمْ رَحِيمًا
en: (66) It is your Lord who drives the ship for you through the sea that you may seek of His bounty. Indeed, He is ever, to you, Merciful.
tr: Rabbukumul-ladhī yuzjī lakumul-fulka fil-baḥri litabtaghū min faḍlih, innahū kāna bikum raḥīmā

ar: وَإِذَا مَسَّكُمُ ٱلضُّرُّ فِى ٱلْبَحْرِ ضَلَّ مَن تَدْعُونَ إِلَّآ إِيَّاهُ فَلَمَّا نَجَّىٰكُمْ إِلَى ٱلْبَرِّ أَعْرَضْتُمْ وَكَانَ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ كَفُورًا
en: (67) And when adversity touches you at sea, lost are [all] those you invoke except for Him. But when He delivers you to the land, you turn away [from Him]. And ever is man ungrateful.
tr: Waʾidhā massakumuḍ-ḍurru fil-baḥri ḍalla man tadʿūna illā iyyāh, falammā najjākum ilal-barri aʿraḍtum, wakānal-insānu kafūrā

ar: أَفَأَمِنتُمْ أَن يَخْسِفَ بِكُمْ جَانِبَ ٱلْبَرِّ أَوْ يُرْسِلَ عَلَيْكُمْ حَاصِبًا ثُمَّ لَا تَجِدُوا۟ لَكُمْ وَكِيلًا
en: (68) Then do you feel secure that [instead] He will not cause a part of the land to swallow you or send against you a storm of stones? Then you would not find for yourselves an advocate.
tr: Afaʾamintum ay yakhsifa bikum jānibal-barri aw yursila ʿalaykum ḥāṣiban thumma lā tajidū lakum wakīlā

ar: أَمْ أَمِنتُمْ أَن يُعِيدَكُمْ فِيهِ تَارَةً أُخْرَىٰ فَيُرْسِلَ عَلَيْكُمْ قَاصِفًا مِّنَ ٱلرِّيحِ فَيُغْرِقَكُم بِمَا كَفَرْتُمْ ثُمَّ لَا تَجِدُوا۟ لَكُمْ عَلَيْنَا بِهِۦ تَبِيعًا
en: (69) Or do you feel secure that He will not send you back into it [i.e., the sea] another time and send upon you a hurricane of wind and drown you for what you denied?[762] Then you would not find for yourselves against Us an avenger.[763]
enNotes:
[762]- Or "for your disbelief."
[763]- Or "someone to demand restitution."
tr: Am amintum ay yuʿīdakum fīhi tāratan ukhrā fayursila ʿalaykum qāṣifam minar-rīḥi fayughriqakum bimā kafartum thumma lā tajidū lakum ʿalaynā bihī tabīʿā

ar: وَلَقَدْ كَرَّمْنَا بَنِىٓ ءَادَمَ وَحَمَلْنَٰهُمْ فِى ٱلْبَرِّ وَٱلْبَحْرِ وَرَزَقْنَٰهُم مِّنَ ٱلطَّيِّبَٰتِ وَفَضَّلْنَٰهُمْ عَلَىٰ كَثِيرٍ مِّمَّنْ خَلَقْنَا تَفْضِيلًا
en: (70) And We have certainly honored the children of Adam and carried them on the land and sea and provided for them of the good things and preferred them over much of what We have created, with [definite] preference.
tr: Walaqad karramnā banī ādama waḥamalnāhum fil-barri wal-baḥri warazaqnāhum minaṭ-ṭayyibāti wafaḍḍalnāhum ʿalā kathīrim mimman khalaqnā tafḍīlā

ar: يَوْمَ نَدْعُوا۟ كُلَّ أُنَاسٍۭ بِإِمَٰمِهِمْ فَمَنْ أُوتِىَ كِتَٰبَهُۥ بِيَمِينِهِۦ فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ يَقْرَءُونَ كِتَٰبَهُمْ وَلَا يُظْلَمُونَ فَتِيلًا
en: (71) [Mention, O Muḥammad], the Day We will call forth every people with their record [of deeds].[764] Then whoever is given his record in his right hand - those will read their records, and injustice will not be done to them, [even] as much as a thread [inside the date seed].
enNotes: [764]- Other meanings are "with their leader" or "with that which they had followed."
tr: Yawma nadʿū kulla unāsim biʾimāmihim, faman ūtiya kitābahū biyamīnihī faʾulāʾika yaqraʾūna kitābahum walā yuẓlamūna fatīlā

ar: وَمَن كَانَ فِى هَٰذِهِۦٓ أَعْمَىٰ فَهُوَ فِى ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ أَعْمَىٰ وَأَضَلُّ سَبِيلًا
en: (72) And whoever is blind[765] in this [life] will be blind in the Hereafter and more astray in way.
enNotes: [765]- i.e., refusing to see the truth.
tr: Waman kāna fī hādhihī aʿmā fahuwa fil-ākhirati aʿmā waʾaḍallu sabīlā

ar: وَإِن كَادُوا۟ لَيَفْتِنُونَكَ عَنِ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَيْكَ لِتَفْتَرِىَ عَلَيْنَا غَيْرَهُۥ وَإِذًا لَّٱتَّخَذُوكَ خَلِيلًا
en: (73) And indeed, they were about to tempt you away from that which We revealed to you in order to [make] you invent about Us something else; and then they would have taken you as a friend.
tr: Waʾin kādū layaftinūnaka ʿanil-ladhī awḥaynā ilayka litaftariya ʿalaynā ghayrah, waʾidhal lattakhadhūka khalīlā

ar: وَلَوْلَآ أَن ثَبَّتْنَٰكَ لَقَدْ كِدتَّ تَرْكَنُ إِلَيْهِمْ شَيْـًٔا قَلِيلًا
en: (74) And if We had not strengthened you, you would have almost inclined to them a little.
tr: Walawlā an thabbatnāka laqad kitta tarkanu ilayhim shayʾan qalīlā

ar: إِذًا لَّأَذَقْنَٰكَ ضِعْفَ ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ وَضِعْفَ ٱلْمَمَاتِ ثُمَّ لَا تَجِدُ لَكَ عَلَيْنَا نَصِيرًا
en: (75) Then [if you had], We would have made you taste double [punishment in] life and double [after] death. Then you would not find for yourself against Us a helper.
tr: Idhal laʾadhaqnāka ḍiʿfal-ḥayāti waḍiʿfal-mamāti thumma lā tajidu laka ʿalaynā naṣīrā

ar: وَإِن كَادُوا۟ لَيَسْتَفِزُّونَكَ مِنَ ٱلْأَرْضِ لِيُخْرِجُوكَ مِنْهَا وَإِذًا لَّا يَلْبَثُونَ خِلَٰفَكَ إِلَّا قَلِيلًا
en: (76) And indeed, they were about to provoke [i.e., drive] you from the land [i.e., Makkah] to evict you therefrom. And then [when they do], they will not remain [there] after you, except for a little.[766]
enNotes: [766]- Only ten years after the Prophet's emigration, Makkah was completely cleared of his enemies.
tr: Waʾin kādū layastafizzūnaka minal-arḍi liyukhrijūka minhā waʾidhal lā yalbathūna khilāfaka illā qalīlā

ar: سُنَّةَ مَن قَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا قَبْلَكَ مِن رُّسُلِنَا وَلَا تَجِدُ لِسُنَّتِنَا تَحْوِيلًا
en: (77) [That is Our] established way for those We had sent before you of Our messengers; and you will not find in Our way any alteration.
tr: Sunnata man qad arsalnā qablaka mir rusulinā walā tajidu lisunnatinā taḥwīlā

ar: أَقِمِ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ لِدُلُوكِ ٱلشَّمْسِ إِلَىٰ غَسَقِ ٱلَّيْلِ وَقُرْءَانَ ٱلْفَجْرِ إِنَّ قُرْءَانَ ٱلْفَجْرِ كَانَ مَشْهُودًا
en: (78) Establish prayer at the decline of the sun [from its meridian] until the darkness of the night[767] and [also] the Qur’ān [i.e., recitation] of dawn.[768] Indeed, the recitation of dawn is ever witnessed.
enNotes:
[767]- i.e., the period which includes the ẓuhr, aṣr, maghrib, and ʿishā’ prayers.
[768]- i.e., the fajr prayer, in which the recitation of the Qur’ān is prolonged.
tr: Aqimiṣ-ṣalāta lidulūkish-shamsi ilā ghasaqil-layli waqurʾānal-fajr, inna qurʾānal-fajri kāna mashhūdā

ar: وَمِنَ ٱلَّيْلِ فَتَهَجَّدْ بِهِۦ نَافِلَةً لَّكَ عَسَىٰٓ أَن يَبْعَثَكَ رَبُّكَ مَقَامًا مَّحْمُودًا
en: (79) And from [part of] the night, pray[769] with it [i.e., recitation of the Qur’ān] as additional [worship] for you; it is expected that[770] your Lord will resurrect you to a praised station.[771]
enNotes:
[769]- Literally, "arise from sleep for prayer."
[770]- This is a promise from Allāh (subḥānahu wa taʿālā) to Prophet Muḥammad (ﷺ).
[771]- The position of intercession by permission of Allāh and the highest degree in Paradise.
tr: Waminal-layli fatahajjad bihī nāfilatal lak, ʿasā ay yabʿathaka rabbuka maqāmam maḥmūdā

ar: وَقُل رَّبِّ أَدْخِلْنِى مُدْخَلَ صِدْقٍ وَأَخْرِجْنِى مُخْرَجَ صِدْقٍ وَٱجْعَل لِّى مِن لَّدُنكَ سُلْطَٰنًا نَّصِيرًا
en: (80) And say, "My Lord, cause me to enter a sound entrance[772] and to exit a sound exit[773] and grant me from Yourself a supporting authority."
enNotes:
[772]- Into Madīnah at the time of emigration, or into the grave.
[773]- From Makkah, or from the grave at the time of resurrection.
tr: Waqur rabbi adkhilnī mudkhala ṣidqiw waʾakhrijnī mukhraja ṣidqiw wajʿal lī mil ladunka sulṭānan naṣīrā

ar: وَقُلْ جَآءَ ٱلْحَقُّ وَزَهَقَ ٱلْبَٰطِلُ إِنَّ ٱلْبَٰطِلَ كَانَ زَهُوقًا
en: (81) And say, "Truth has come, and falsehood has departed. Indeed is falsehood, [by nature], ever bound to depart."
tr: Waqul jāʾal-ḥaqqu wazahaqal-bāṭil, innal-bāṭila kāna zahūqā

ar: وَنُنَزِّلُ مِنَ ٱلْقُرْءَانِ مَا هُوَ شِفَآءٌ وَرَحْمَةٌ لِّلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَلَا يَزِيدُ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ إِلَّا خَسَارًا
en: (82) And We send down of the Qur’ān that which is healing and mercy for the believers, but it does not increase the wrongdoers except in loss.
tr: Wanunazzilu minal-qurʾāni mā huwa shifāʾuw waraḥmatul lil-muʾminīna walā yazīduẓ-ẓālimīna illā khasārā

ar: وَإِذَآ أَنْعَمْنَا عَلَى ٱلْإِنسَٰنِ أَعْرَضَ وَنَـَٔا بِجَانِبِهِۦ وَإِذَا مَسَّهُ ٱلشَّرُّ كَانَ يَـُٔوسًا
en: (83) And when We bestow favor upon man [i.e., the disbeliever], he turns away and distances himself; and when evil touches him, he is ever despairing.
tr: Waʾidhā anʿamnā ʿalal-insāni aʿraḍa wanaʾā bijānibih, waʾidhā massahush-sharru kāna yaʾūsā

ar: قُلْ كُلٌّ يَعْمَلُ عَلَىٰ شَاكِلَتِهِۦ فَرَبُّكُمْ أَعْلَمُ بِمَنْ هُوَ أَهْدَىٰ سَبِيلًا
en: (84) Say, "Each works according to his manner, but your Lord is most knowing of who is best guided in way."
tr: Qul kulluy yaʿmalu ʿalā shākilatih, farabbukum aʿlamu biman huwa ahdā sabīlā

ar: وَيَسْـَٔلُونَكَ عَنِ ٱلرُّوحِ قُلِ ٱلرُّوحُ مِنْ أَمْرِ رَبِّى وَمَآ أُوتِيتُم مِّنَ ٱلْعِلْمِ إِلَّا قَلِيلًا
en: (85) And they ask you, [O Muḥammad], about the soul. Say, "The soul is of the affair [i.e., concern] of my Lord. And you [i.e., mankind] have not been given of knowledge except a little."
tr: Wayasʾalūnaka ʿanir-rūḥ, qulir-rūḥu min amri rabbī wamā ūtītum minal-ʿilmi illā qalīlā

ar: وَلَئِن شِئْنَا لَنَذْهَبَنَّ بِٱلَّذِىٓ أَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَيْكَ ثُمَّ لَا تَجِدُ لَكَ بِهِۦ عَلَيْنَا وَكِيلًا
en: (86) And if We willed, We could surely do away with that which We revealed to you. Then you would not find for yourself concerning it an advocate against Us.
tr: Walaʾin shiʾnā lanadhhabanna bil-ladhī awḥaynā ilayka thumma lā tajidu laka bihī ʿalaynā wakīlā

ar: إِلَّا رَحْمَةً مِّن رَّبِّكَ إِنَّ فَضْلَهُۥ كَانَ عَلَيْكَ كَبِيرًا
en: (87) Except [We have left it with you] as a mercy from your Lord. Indeed, His favor upon you has ever been great.
tr: Illā raḥmatam mir rabbik, inna faḍlahū kāna ʿalayka kabīrā

ar: قُل لَّئِنِ ٱجْتَمَعَتِ ٱلْإِنسُ وَٱلْجِنُّ عَلَىٰٓ أَن يَأْتُوا۟ بِمِثْلِ هَٰذَا ٱلْقُرْءَانِ لَا يَأْتُونَ بِمِثْلِهِۦ وَلَوْ كَانَ بَعْضُهُمْ لِبَعْضٍ ظَهِيرًا
en: (88) Say, "If mankind and the jinn gathered in order to produce the like of this Qur’ān, they could not produce the like of it, even if they were to each other assistants."
tr: Qul laʾinijtamaʿatil-insu wal-jinnu ʿalā ay yaʾtū bimithli hādhal-qurʾāni lā yaʾtūna bimithlihī walaw kāna baʿḍuhum libaʿḍin ẓahīrā

ar: وَلَقَدْ صَرَّفْنَا لِلنَّاسِ فِى هَٰذَا ٱلْقُرْءَانِ مِن كُلِّ مَثَلٍ فَأَبَىٰٓ أَكْثَرُ ٱلنَّاسِ إِلَّا كُفُورًا
en: (89) And We have certainly diversified for the people in this Qur’ān from every [kind of] example, but most of the people refused except disbelief.
tr: Walaqad ṣarrafnā lin-nāsi fī hādhal-qurʾāni min kulli mathal, faʾabā aktharun-nāsi illā kufūrā

ar: وَقَالُوا۟ لَن نُّؤْمِنَ لَكَ حَتَّىٰ تَفْجُرَ لَنَا مِنَ ٱلْأَرْضِ يَنۢبُوعًا
en: (90) And they say, "We will not believe you until you break open for us from the ground a spring
tr: Waqālū lan nuʾmina laka ḥattā tafjura lanā minal-arḍi yambūʿā

ar: أَوْ تَكُونَ لَكَ جَنَّةٌ مِّن نَّخِيلٍ وَعِنَبٍ فَتُفَجِّرَ ٱلْأَنْهَٰرَ خِلَٰلَهَا تَفْجِيرًا
en: (91) Or [until] you have a garden of palm trees and grapes and make rivers gush forth within them in force [and abundance]
tr: Aw takūna laka jannatum min nakhīliw waʿinabin fatufajjiral-anhāra khilālahā tafjīrā

ar: أَوْ تُسْقِطَ ٱلسَّمَآءَ كَمَا زَعَمْتَ عَلَيْنَا كِسَفًا أَوْ تَأْتِىَ بِٱللَّهِ وَٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةِ قَبِيلًا
en: (92) Or you make the heaven fall upon us in fragments as you have claimed or you bring Allāh and the angels before [us]
tr: Aw tusqiṭas-samāʾa kamā zaʿamta ʿalaynā kisafan aw taʾtiya billāhi wal-malāʾikati qabīlā

ar: أَوْ يَكُونَ لَكَ بَيْتٌ مِّن زُخْرُفٍ أَوْ تَرْقَىٰ فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَلَن نُّؤْمِنَ لِرُقِيِّكَ حَتَّىٰ تُنَزِّلَ عَلَيْنَا كِتَٰبًا نَّقْرَؤُهُۥ قُلْ سُبْحَانَ رَبِّى هَلْ كُنتُ إِلَّا بَشَرًا رَّسُولًا
en: (93) Or you have a house of ornament [i.e., gold] or you ascend into the sky. And [even then], we will not believe in your ascension until you bring down to us a book we may read." Say, "Exalted is my Lord! Was I ever but a human messenger?"
tr: Aw yakūna laka baytum min zukhrufin aw tarqā fis-samāʾ, walan nuʾmina liruqiyyika ḥattā tunazzila ʿalaynā kitāban naqraʾuh, qul subḥāna rabbī hal kuntu illā basharar rasūlā

ar: وَمَا مَنَعَ ٱلنَّاسَ أَن يُؤْمِنُوٓا۟ إِذْ جَآءَهُمُ ٱلْهُدَىٰٓ إِلَّآ أَن قَالُوٓا۟ أَبَعَثَ ٱللَّهُ بَشَرًا رَّسُولًا
en: (94) And what prevented the people from believing when guidance came to them except that they said, "Has Allāh sent a human messenger?"
tr: Wamā manaʿan-nāsa ay yuʾminū idh jāʾahumul-hudā illā an qālū abaʿathallāhu basharar rasūlā

ar: قُل لَّوْ كَانَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ مَلَٰٓئِكَةٌ يَمْشُونَ مُطْمَئِنِّينَ لَنَزَّلْنَا عَلَيْهِم مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَلَكًا رَّسُولًا
en: (95) Say, "If there were upon the earth angels walking securely,[774] We would have sent down to them from the heaven an angel [as a] messenger."
enNotes: [774]- i.e., who were settled and established there, as is man.
tr: Qul law kāna fil-arḍi malāʾikatuy yamshūna muṭmaʾinnīna lanazzalnā ʿalayhim minas-samāʾi malakar rasūlā

ar: قُلْ كَفَىٰ بِٱللَّهِ شَهِيدًۢا بَيْنِى وَبَيْنَكُمْ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ بِعِبَادِهِۦ خَبِيرًۢا بَصِيرًا
en: (96) Say, "Sufficient is Allāh as Witness between me and you. Indeed He is ever, concerning His servants, Aware and Seeing."
tr: Qul kafā billāhi shahīdam baynī wabaynakum, innahū kāna biʿibādihī khabīram baṣīrā

ar: وَمَن يَهْدِ ٱللَّهُ فَهُوَ ٱلْمُهْتَدِ وَمَن يُضْلِلْ فَلَن تَجِدَ لَهُمْ أَوْلِيَآءَ مِن دُونِهِۦ وَنَحْشُرُهُمْ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ عَلَىٰ وُجُوهِهِمْ عُمْيًا وَبُكْمًا وَصُمًّا مَّأْوَىٰهُمْ جَهَنَّمُ كُلَّمَا خَبَتْ زِدْنَٰهُمْ سَعِيرًا
en: (97) And whoever Allāh guides - he is the [rightly] guided; and whoever He sends astray[775] - you will never find for them protectors besides Him, and We will gather them on the Day of Resurrection [fallen] on their faces - blind, dumb and deaf. Their refuge is Hell; every time it subsides, We increase [for] them blazing fire.
enNotes: [775]- As a result of his own preference.
tr: Wamay yahdillāhu fahuwal-muhtad, wamay yuḍlil falan tajida lahum awliyāʾa min dūnih, wanaḥshuruhum yawmal-qiyāmati ʿalā wujūhihim ʿumyaw wabukmaw waṣummā, maʾwāhum jahannam, kullamā khabat zidnāhum saʿīrā

ar: ذَٰلِكَ جَزَآؤُهُم بِأَنَّهُمْ كَفَرُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا وَقَالُوٓا۟ أَءِذَا كُنَّا عِظَٰمًا وَرُفَٰتًا أَءِنَّا لَمَبْعُوثُونَ خَلْقًا جَدِيدًا
en: (98) That is their recompense because they disbelieved in Our verses and said, "When we are bones and crumbled particles, will we [truly] be resurrected [in] a new creation?"
tr: Dhālika jazāʾuhum biʾannahum kafarū biʾāyātinā waqālū aʾidhā kunnā ʿiẓāmaw warufātan aʾinnā lamabʿūthūna khalqan jadīdā

ar: أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ قَادِرٌ عَلَىٰٓ أَن يَخْلُقَ مِثْلَهُمْ وَجَعَلَ لَهُمْ أَجَلًا لَّا رَيْبَ فِيهِ فَأَبَى ٱلظَّٰلِمُونَ إِلَّا كُفُورًا
en: (99) Do they not see that Allāh, who created the heavens and earth, is [the one] Able to create the likes of them? And He has appointed for them a term, about which there is no doubt. But the wrongdoers refuse except disbelief.
tr: Awalam yaraw annallāhal-ladhī khalaqas-samāwāti wal-arḍa qādirun ʿalā ay yakhluqa mithlahum wajaʿala lahum ajalal lā rayba fīh, faʾabaẓ-ẓālimūna illā kufūrā

ar: قُل لَّوْ أَنتُمْ تَمْلِكُونَ خَزَآئِنَ رَحْمَةِ رَبِّىٓ إِذًا لَّأَمْسَكْتُمْ خَشْيَةَ ٱلْإِنفَاقِ وَكَانَ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ قَتُورًا
en: (100) Say [to them], "If you possessed the depositories of the mercy of my Lord, then you would withhold out of fear of spending." And ever has man been stingy.
tr: Qul law antum tamlikūna khazāʾina raḥmati rabbī idhal laʾamsaktum khashyatal-infāq, wakānal-insānu qatūrā

ar: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا مُوسَىٰ تِسْعَ ءَايَٰتٍۭ بَيِّنَٰتٍ فَسْـَٔلْ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ إِذْ جَآءَهُمْ فَقَالَ لَهُۥ فِرْعَوْنُ إِنِّى لَأَظُنُّكَ يَٰمُوسَىٰ مَسْحُورًا
en: (101) And We had certainly given Moses nine evident signs, so ask the Children of Israel [about] when he came to them and Pharaoh said to him, "Indeed I think, O Moses, that you are affected by magic."
tr: Walaqad ātaynā mūsā tisʿa āyātim bayyinātin fasʾal banī isrāʾīla idh jāʾahum faqāla lahū firʿawnu innī laʾaẓunnuka yāmūsā masḥūrā

ar: قَالَ لَقَدْ عَلِمْتَ مَآ أَنزَلَ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ إِلَّا رَبُّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ بَصَآئِرَ وَإِنِّى لَأَظُنُّكَ يَٰفِرْعَوْنُ مَثْبُورًا
en: (102) [Moses] said, "You have already known that none has sent down these [signs] except the Lord of the heavens and the earth as evidence, and indeed I think,[776] O Pharaoh, that you are destroyed."
enNotes: [776]- i.e., I am certain.
tr: Qāla laqad ʿalimta mā anzala hāʾulāʾi illā rabbus-samāwāti wal-arḍi baṣāʾir, waʾinnī laʾaẓunnuka yāfirʿawnu mathbūrā

ar: فَأَرَادَ أَن يَسْتَفِزَّهُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَرْضِ فَأَغْرَقْنَٰهُ وَمَن مَّعَهُۥ جَمِيعًا
en: (103) So he intended to drive them from the land, but We drowned him and those with him all together.
tr: Faʾarāda ay yastafizzahum minal-arḍi faʾaghraqnāhu wamam maʿahū jamīʿā

ar: وَقُلْنَا مِنۢ بَعْدِهِۦ لِبَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ ٱسْكُنُوا۟ ٱلْأَرْضَ فَإِذَا جَآءَ وَعْدُ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ جِئْنَا بِكُمْ لَفِيفًا
en: (104) And We said after him [i.e., Pharaoh] to the Children of Israel, "Dwell in the land, and when there comes the promise [i.e., appointment] of the Hereafter, We will bring you forth in [one] gathering."
tr: Waqulnā mim baʿdihī libanī isrāʾīlaskunul-arḍa faʾidhā jāʾa waʿdul-ākhirati jiʾnā bikum lafīfā

ar: وَبِٱلْحَقِّ أَنزَلْنَٰهُ وَبِٱلْحَقِّ نَزَلَ وَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَٰكَ إِلَّا مُبَشِّرًا وَنَذِيرًا
en: (105) And with the truth We have sent it [i.e., the Qur’ān] down, and with the truth it has descended. And We have not sent you, [O Muḥammad], except as a bringer of good tidings and a warner.
tr: Wabil-ḥaqqi anzalnāhu wabil-ḥaqqi nazal, wamā arsalnāka illā mubashshiraw wanadhīrā

ar: وَقُرْءَانًا فَرَقْنَٰهُ لِتَقْرَأَهُۥ عَلَى ٱلنَّاسِ عَلَىٰ مُكْثٍ وَنَزَّلْنَٰهُ تَنزِيلًا
en: (106) And [it is] a Qur’ān which We have separated [by intervals] that you might recite it to the people over a prolonged period. And We have sent it down progressively.
tr: Waqurʾānan faraqnāhu litaqraʾahū ʿalan-nāsi ʿalā mukthiw wanazzalnāhu tanzīlā

ar: قُلْ ءَامِنُوا۟ بِهِۦٓ أَوْ لَا تُؤْمِنُوٓا۟ إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْعِلْمَ مِن قَبْلِهِۦٓ إِذَا يُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِمْ يَخِرُّونَ لِلْأَذْقَانِ سُجَّدًا
en: (107) Say, "Believe in it or do not believe." Indeed, those who were given knowledge before it[777] - when it is recited to them, they fall upon their faces in prostration,
enNotes: [777]- i.e., the righteous among the People of the Scriptures who recognize the truth contained in the Qur’ān.
tr: Qul āminū bihī aw lā tuʾminū, innal-ladhīna ūtul-ʿilma min qablihī idhā yutlā ʿalayhim yakhirrūna lil-adhqāni sujjadā

ar: وَيَقُولُونَ سُبْحَٰنَ رَبِّنَآ إِن كَانَ وَعْدُ رَبِّنَا لَمَفْعُولًا
en: (108) And they say, "Exalted is our Lord! Indeed, the promise of our Lord has been fulfilled."
tr: Wayaqūlūna subḥāna rabbinā in kāna waʿdu rabbinā lamafʿūlā

ar: وَيَخِرُّونَ لِلْأَذْقَانِ يَبْكُونَ وَيَزِيدُهُمْ خُشُوعًا
en: (109) And they fall upon their faces weeping, and it [i.e., the Qur’ān] increases them in humble submission.
tr: Wayakhirrūna lil-adhqāni yabkūna wayazīduhum khushūʿā

ar: قُلِ ٱدْعُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ أَوِ ٱدْعُوا۟ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنَ أَيًّا مَّا تَدْعُوا۟ فَلَهُ ٱلْأَسْمَآءُ ٱلْحُسْنَىٰ وَلَا تَجْهَرْ بِصَلَاتِكَ وَلَا تُخَافِتْ بِهَا وَٱبْتَغِ بَيْنَ ذَٰلِكَ سَبِيلًا
en: (110) Say, "Call upon Allāh or call upon the Most Merciful [ar-Raḥmān]. Whichever [name] you call - to Him belong the best names." And do not recite [too] loudly in your prayer or [too] quietly but seek between that an [intermediate] way.
tr: Qulidʿullāha awidʿur-raḥmān, ayyam mā tadʿū falahul-asmāʾul-ḥusnā, walā tajhar biṣalātika walā tukhāfit bihā wabtaghi bayna dhālika sabīlā

ar: وَقُلِ ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِى لَمْ يَتَّخِذْ وَلَدًا وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُۥ شَرِيكٌ فِى ٱلْمُلْكِ وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُۥ وَلِىٌّ مِّنَ ٱلذُّلِّ وَكَبِّرْهُ تَكْبِيرًۢا
en: (111) And say, "Praise to Allāh, who has not taken a son and has had no partner in [His] dominion and has no [need of a] protector out of weakness; and glorify Him with [great] glorification."
tr: Waqulil-ḥamdu lillāhil-ladhī lam yattakhidh waladaw walam yakul lahū sharīkun fil-mulki walam yakul lahū waliyyum minadh-dhulli wakabbirhu takbīrā
